<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="changelog">
<h1>Changelog</h1>
<section id="version-0-0-4-tbd">
<h2>Version 0.0.4 (TBD)</h2>
<p><strong>Bug Fixes:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Fixed deprecated <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">local_dir_use_symlinks</span></code> parameter in HuggingFace downloads (removes deprecation warnings)</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed Windows CI test failures related to temporary file permissions in encoding detection tests</p></li>
<li><p>Properly close temporary files before deletion to support Windows file locking behavior</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Breaking Changes:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Removed redundant <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">v1.1-zh-hf</span></code> model variant - Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">model_variant=&quot;v1.1-zh&quot;</span></code> with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">model_source=&quot;huggingface&quot;</span></code> instead</p></li>
<li><p>Changed cache directory structure to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">~/.cache/pykokoro/{models|voices}/{source}/{variant}/</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>Removed deprecated functions: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">download_model_hf_v11zh()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">download_voices_hf_v11zh()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">download_all_models_hf_v11zh()</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>Function signatures updated: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">download_model()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">download_voice()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">download_all_voices()</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">download_all_models()</span></code> now require <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">variant</span></code> parameter</p></li>
<li><p>Path helper functions <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">get_model_dir()</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">get_voices_dir()</span></code> now require <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">variant</span></code> parameters</p></li>
<li><p><strong>API Simplification:</strong> Replaced <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">split_mode</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">trim_silence</span></code> parameters with single <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_mode</span></code> parameter in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Kokoro.create()</span></code></p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Migration Guide:</strong></p>
<p>For users upgrading from v0.0.3:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Old (v0.3.x) - NO LONGER WORKS</span>
<span class="n">kokoro</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Kokoro</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">model_variant</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;v1.1-zh-hf&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">download_model_hf_v11zh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">quality</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;fp16&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># New (v0.4.0+)</span>
<span class="n">kokoro</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Kokoro</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">model_source</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;huggingface&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">model_variant</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;v1.1-zh&quot;</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">download_model</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">variant</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;v1.1-zh&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">quality</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;fp16&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Old pause control (v0.3.x) - NO LONGER WORKS</span>
<span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">kokoro</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">create</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;af_bella&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">split_mode</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;clause&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">trim_silence</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">pause_clause</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.25</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># New pause control (v0.4.0+)</span>
<span class="c1"># Default: TTS controls pauses naturally</span>
<span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">kokoro</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">create</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;af_bella&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Manual pause control</span>
<span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">kokoro</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">create</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;af_bella&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">pause_mode</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;manual&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="c1"># PyKokoro controls pauses precisely</span>
    <span class="n">pause_clause</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.25</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">pause_sentence</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.5</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">pause_paragraph</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.0</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>pause_mode Parameter:</strong></p>
<p>The new <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_mode</span></code> parameter simplifies pause control:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_mode=&quot;tts&quot;</span></code> (default): TTS generates pauses naturally. Best for most content.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_mode=&quot;manual&quot;</span></code>: PyKokoro controls pauses precisely. Best for podcasts, voice switching, and precise timing.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_mode=&quot;auto&quot;</span></code>: PyKokoro inserts pauses at sentence/paragraph boundaries and trims silence.</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Improvements:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Unified path structure across all model sources and variants</p></li>
<li><p>Consolidated duplicate download functions for cleaner API</p></li>
<li><p>Shared configuration files between HuggingFace and GitHub sources</p></li>
<li><p>Improved code maintainability with consistent path handling</p></li>

<li><p>Added pause markers: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">(.)</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">(..)</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">(...)</span></code> for controlling speech pauses (DEPRECATED - use SSMD break syntax instead: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">...c</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">...s</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">...p</span></code>)</p></li>
<li><p>Added <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_short</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_medium</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_long</span></code> parameters for custom pause durations</p></li>
<li><p>Added <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">split_mode</span></code> parameter to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">create()</span></code> for intelligent text splitting (DEPRECATED in v0.4.0 - use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_mode</span></code> instead)</p></li>
<li><p>Added <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">trim_silence</span></code> parameter for removing silence between segments (DEPRECATED in v0.4.0 - use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_mode=&quot;manual&quot;</span></code> instead)</p></li>
<li><p>Added <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_after</span></code> field to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PhonemeSegment</span></code> class</p></li>

<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
